description: This file declares the AttachSource class, which implements the IPlayerTask interface for attaching media sources in a GStreamer-based media player. It includes method declarations for executing the task, adding, updating, and switching sources, and creating media caps and audio attributes. The class interacts with various wrappers and context objects to manage media source attachment within the Rialto media server.

classes.name: AttachSource
classes.description: A class responsible for attaching media sources to the GStreamer pipeline within the Rialto media server, implementing the IPlayerTask interface.

methods.name: AttachSource
methods.description: Constructor initializing the AttachSource task with necessary context, wrappers, player interface, and media source.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the attach source task, performing the necessary steps to attach a media source.

methods.name: addSource
methods.description: Adds a media source to the pipeline, given media caps and DRM status.

methods.name: updateSource
methods.description: Updates the existing media source with new caps or configuration.

methods.name: switchAudioSource
methods.description: Switches the audio source within the media pipeline.

methods.name: createCapsFromMediaSource
methods.description: Creates GstCaps object from the current media source.

methods.name: createAudioAttributes
methods.description: Creates audio attributes for the media source.
